notes: In 986 of 2,407 region-animal records, the base ration's dry matter falls outside the file's DMIN-DMAX range (worst: HR000000 broilers 2.4x DMAX). The ration model widens the DM bounds, and lowers the energy and protein requirements, to fit the base ration (CAPRI's p_trimFeed). So the file's requirements are not what binds at calibration. (checked 2026-10-29)

capri_data/codes/model_units.csv.description: The model's own units that CAPRI's unit catalogue (CAPRIunits.gms) lacks: code, description and the tables using it; hand-kept, no builder; tools/build/build_unit_catalogue.py adds them to units.csv with capri = no.

capri_data/codes/nuts_version_correspond.description: CAPRI's 8-character region codes and their NUTS codes across coding-scheme versions, in order (a code can have several: IT110000 -> IT11 and ITC1; an empty nuts_code for a code without one), from CAPRI's gams/compile_rdp_data/build_general_set_structure.gms, with 75 NUTS-2 pairs added in October 2026 (each verified by CAPRI's total agricultural area against the model region's base area and a second variable), NO090000 -> NO03 and PL500000 -> PL81 removed as unconfirmed, and FI190000 -> FI1C removed; read by tools/lib/_model_regions.py (with its CORR_FIXES, SPLITS_MERGES). nuts_version_correspondence.json until 31 October 2026, kept by hand (capri_mod/data/nested_tables.py)
notes: CAPRI's 8-character region codes and their NUTS codes across versions, kept by hand (no builder): 281 rows, 217 CAPRI codes, 279 pairs, two codes (NO090000, PL500000) without a NUTS code. Converted on 31 October 2026 from shared/nuts_version_correspondence.json, whose capri8_to_nuts it equals exactly (order included); that file stated its origin as CAPRI's gams/compile_rdp_data/build_general_set_structure.gms (207 pairs) with 75 NUTS-2 pairs added in October 2026 and three removed (its _note, now the table's comment). Checked today against that GAMS file: 228 of the 279 pairs are in CAPRI's set r2_nutsRd (pairs read with a simple pattern), 51 are not; the difference to the 75 stated additions was not resolved. Read by tools/lib/_model_regions.py (_nuts_correspondence: capri_groups, region_to_capri, with CORR_FIXES and SPLITS_MERGES), not by the model. (checked 2026-10-31)
